name: test_user_role_permission_set_cleanup_removes_dependencies_in_order
description:
Objective: User role permission set cleanup removes dependencies in order.
Preconditions: Open Admin data cleanup with the configured test data.
Steps:
1. Open Admin data cleanup.
2. User role permission set cleanup removes dependencies in order.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: A complete configured app-owned access chain must leave no stale Admin records.
